title: Founder's Office Intern
cardDesc: Work directly with Myntmore's founder on live growth projects, systems, and day-to-day business priorities.
cardBullets: Build SOPs, systems and AI workflows
schemaDescription: Myntmore, a Mumbai-based B2B lead generation and outbound growth agency, is hiring a Founder's Office Intern to work directly with founder Tejas Jhaveri. You will drive day-to-day priorities, support his Fractional CMO work across 6+ client companies, manage his calendar and follow-ups, and build SOPs and AI-led systems. The internship is full-time in office in Mumbai, with at least 6 hours a day between 10:00 AM and 7:30 PM. The stipend is ₹7,000–15,000 per month based on experience, with a PPO based on performance.
aboutIntro:
This is not a "watch and learn" internship. You'll be in the room where work actually happens, working directly with the founder and core team on live growth projects. That is the same work we do for paying clients.
You'll build lead lists from scratch using LinkedIn, Apollo and research tools. You'll write and launch real LinkedIn and cold email campaigns, and use AI and automation to speed up manual work. You'll also track replies and book meetings, and see how conversations turn into pipeline.
This role is for someone who wants to understand how businesses grow from the inside, and who is excited to learn tools, test ideas, and take ownership early.

primaryGoal: Be the founder's execution partner, turning ideas into action and making sure nothing important slips through the cracks.

responsibilities.title: Founder's Office Execution:
responsibilities.desc: Work directly with the founder on day-to-day priorities, turn ideas into action, and make sure tasks and follow-ups don't slip.

responsibilities.title: Support FCMO Responsibilities:
responsibilities.desc: The founder is a Fractional CMO for 6+ companies. You'll prepare notes, research and follow-ups for client strategy calls, track deliverables, and support campaign planning and execution.

responsibilities.title: Calendar & Priority Management:
responsibilities.desc: Keep the founder's time on high-impact work, prepare briefs before meetings, and track action items after calls until they're done.

responsibilities.title: Systems & Process Building:
responsibilities.desc: Document repeatable workflows as SOPs and find manual tasks that tools or AI can automate.

responsibilities.title: Operations & Accountability:
responsibilities.desc: Track key priorities, follow up with team members to keep projects moving, and keep communication between teams smooth.

responsibilities.title: Business Growth Support:
responsibilities.desc: Help with research, partnerships, new initiatives, experiments, tool testing, and internal improvement projects.

whoYouAreIntro: This role is for someone who wants to become a business generalist rather than do one narrow job.

whoYouAre.label: You think like an operator:
whoYouAre.desc: You think in systems and efficiency, you organise chaos, and you figure things out without waiting to be told every step.

whoYouAre.label: You're extremely organised:
whoYouAre.desc: You love lists and trackers, you notice when something is about to slip, and you're comfortable following up.

whoYouAre.label: You enjoy tools, AI & automation:
whoYouAre.desc: You're curious about new software, and dashboards, CRMs and Notion don't scare you.

whoYouAre.label: You're comfortable with ambiguity:
whoYouAre.desc: You can handle "figure this out" and shifting priorities, and you stay calm under pressure.

whoYouAre.label: You're a strong communicator:
whoYouAre.desc: You write clear notes and summaries, you're professional on calls, and you ask good questions.

whoYouAre.label: You care about growth:
whoYouAre.desc: You want steep learning, real responsibility, and close exposure to a founder.

skills: Experience with Notion, Google Sheets, Zapier, ChatGPT, Airtable or any automation tool
Experience organising projects, events or team work
